final: WITH linked_data AS (SELECT ab.abhvreg, ab.translink, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), pair_counts AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, COUNT(*) as pair_count FROM linked_data GROUP BY translink, tradekind), trader_type_totals AS (SELECT tradekind, SUM(pair_count) as total_count FROM pair_counts GROUP BY tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT pc.translink, pc.tradekind, pc.pair_count, CAST(pc.pair_count AS FLOAT) / ttt.total_count as share FROM pair_counts pc JOIN trader_type_totals ttt ON pc.tradekind = ttt.tradekind), trader_type_avg_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT ps.translink, ps.tradekind, ps.pair_count, ps.share, ttas.avg_share FROM pair_shares ps JOIN trader_type_avg_shares ttas ON ps.tradekind = ttas.tradekind WHERE ps.share >= ttas.avg_share) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_count) as avg_pair_count, AVG(share) as avg_share_kept, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess FROM filtered_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind    -- Result: Broker (1.0, 0.004098360655737681, 2.42861286636753e-17); Individual (2.0, 0.008264462809917356, 0.004115085216556371)
